quick: the source-sync check (drift or conflict fails) plus journeys tagged smoke; no YAML tests
default: source-sync checks, generated + app YAML tests in a disposable source copy, schema/OpenAPI fingerprints, and every journey
release: default plus read-only status/doctor analysis; ordinary dev→prod code drift is informational, while destructive schema changes, missing prod env refs, key/payment mistakes, money-as-float, secrets, and PII exposure block
